answer: Debut agents deposit escrow that stays locked until N consecutive epochs of attested work, each attestation time-locked so no agent can fast-forward its own aging. That bond is the anchor tying identity to real capital: a sybil operator must fund and nurse every puppet across the whole warm-up, so per-fake cost rises steeply until the economics flatten into a canyon no cheap identity nebula can climb, while honest growers simply outlast the bluff.
